name: terraform-module
description: Generate a Terraform module from a described need, with main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf and versions.tf, typed and validated variables, secure defaults (encryption on, public access off, least-privilege IAM), a merged tags variable, a basic usage example and a README with inputs and outputs tables. Use when the user says "write a terraform module for", "create terraform for an S3 bucket / VPC / database", "turn this into a reusable module", or "scaffold infrastructure as code for".

handoff.when: the module has been planned from examples/basic or a real caller
handoff.purpose: Check the plan for destroys, stateful changes and access widening before the first apply.
handoff.fallback: If terraform-plan-review is absent, read the plan for any -/+ or destroy lines and any 0.0.0.0/0 or wildcard IAM before applying.

model.rationale: Structured generation against fixed module conventions and a secure-defaults checklist; the judgment is bounded to choosing defaults and validation rules for a described need.
